[[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] defeated [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] in [[2019 Munster Senior Hurling Championship Final|the final]]. ==Teams== The Munster championship was contested by five of the six counties from the Irish province of [[Munster]].
